1. Who We Are

DevHems Technology ("we", "us", "our") operates devhems.com. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and how you can control it.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information you submit through our contact, enquiry, service, project and career application forms (name, email, phone, company, job application details and uploaded resumes), plus standard analytics data (pages visited, device/browser type, approximate location) via Google Analytics and similar tools.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to respond to enquiries, deliver requested services, evaluate job applications, send you information you've asked for, and improve our website's performance and content.

4. Cookies

We use cookies for essential site functionality, analytics and (where applicable) advertising retargeting. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

5. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with service providers who help us operate the site (e.g. email delivery, hosting, spam protection) under confidentiality obligations, or where required by law.

6. Data Retention

We retain submitted form data (stored via Flamingo) and job applications only as long as necessary for the purpose they were collected for, or as required by law.

7. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your personal data. Contact us at privacy@devhems.com to exercise these rights.

8. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, but no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy periodically. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

10. Contact Us

Questions about this policy? Email privacy@devhems.com.
